subject.title: feat(gateway): handle Feishu VC meeting invites

question: Does subscribing the Feishu app to `vc.bot.meeting_invited_v1`, combined with a user inviting the bot, constitute sufficient opt-in for OpenClaw to start an automatic meeting-join agent turn?
rationale: The code and proof establish a viable implementation, but upgrading an already-subscribed installation can activate a new visible write workflow; repository policy requires maintainer intent for that compatibility and consent boundary.

options.title: Use event subscription as opt-in
options.body: Keep the current no-extra-switch design because the dedicated subscription and explicit meeting invitation together express operator and user intent.

options.title: Require an OpenClaw gate
options.body: Add a documented default-off Feishu setting and cover fresh-install and upgrade behavior before enabling invite-triggered turns.

recommendation.title: Use event subscription as opt-in
recommendation.body: Keep the current no-extra-switch design because the dedicated subscription and explicit meeting invitation together express operator and user intent.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored and force-pushed the latest ownership and routing refactors and are the strongest available decision owner for the remaining product boundary.
